agnostic_oa_invariant_preserving_reducti.interpretation: The source separates semantic correctness of an allowed simplification from the search problem of finding a good simplification. Finding an optimal partial matching is nevertheless NP-complete, so implementations rely on heuristic searches. Other named collapses have their own preservation contracts, while the tidy-set method does not extend to ordinary filtered complexes. A hard optimization layer does not weaken the exact preservation guarantee of each admissible move, but it does limit efficiency claims.
